title: The roundabout by the oval: Bay Rd / Victoria St / George Main Rd
why: Asked about by residents ('by the oval, near the caravan park, police station and school'). The only roundabout there: Victor Harbor High School is about 100 m north, Victor Harbor Oval about 150 m north-east, the Beachfront Holiday Park about 290 m south, Victor Harbor Holiday Park and the police station 330-500 m west. Victoria St / Oval Rd (a give-way T, 330 m east) is part of the Victoria St hotspot.
